title: Desktop images are now a thing for riscv64 as well.
description:
Desktop images are now a thing for riscv64 as well.
Those needs special kernel parameters for plymouth. Append them here.
Also add "ignore-serial-consoles" as those are common for riscv64 boards and do not interact well with plymouth.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index ea01278..0169f2f 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+livecd-rootfs (26.10.16) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * riscv64: append "quiet splash plymouth.ignore-serial-consoles"
+    to non-server isos kernel command-line (LP: #2168989)
+
+ -- Valentin Haudiquet <valentin.haudiquet@canonical.com>  Wed, 30 Sep 2026 11:11:35 +0200
+
 livecd-rootfs (26.10.15) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   * Remove -v from the losetup calls because util-linux 2.42 has removed this
diff --git a/live-build/isobuilder/boot/riscv64.py b/live-build/isobuilder/boot/riscv64.py
index 2aaea21..3173a6c 100644
--- a/live-build/isobuilder/boot/riscv64.py
+++ b/live-build/isobuilder/boot/riscv64.py
@@ -118,11 +118,15 @@ class RISCV64BootConfigurator(GrubBootConfigurator):
         """Generate grub.cfg for RISC-V64."""
         result = self.grub_header(include_loadfont=False)
 
+        kernel_params = "efi=debug sysctl.kernel.watchdog_thresh=60 "
+        if self.project != "ubuntu-server":
+            kernel_params += "quiet splash plymouth.ignore-serial-consoles "
+
         # Main menu entry
         result += f"""\
 menuentry "Try or Install {self.humanproject}" {{
     set gfxpayload=keep
-    linux  /casper/vmlinux efi=debug sysctl.kernel.watchdog_thresh=60 ---
+    linux  /casper/vmlinux {kernel_params}---
     initrd /casper/initrd
 }}
 """
@@ -131,7 +135,7 @@ menuentry "Try or Install {self.humanproject}" {{
         result += self.hwe_menu_entry(
             "vmlinux",
             "---",
-            extra_params="efi=debug sysctl.kernel.watchdog_thresh=60 ",
+            extra_params=kernel_params,
         )
 
         return result
